title: John Mack persecuted by Harvard over his abduction research
summary: Jesse Michels tells of John Mack persecuted by Harvard over his abduction research, about 1990s at Harvard, Cambridge, Massachusetts, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and he was persecuted by by Harvard there was a trial there

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that John Mack, a psychiatrist at Harvard University who studied people who reported being abducted by aliens, was persecuted by Harvard in the 1990s for that work. According to Michels, there was even a trial held there over it, which he presents as a sign of how hard it is for respected scientists to take such accounts seriously.
